message:
Command `cd /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gnutls && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.in/42b9ea0c0638639fb74a2bc1f2adb1c891b6cc90')
trace=[
{"step":1,"file":"fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":22,"var":"data,size","code":"gnutls_datum_t raw = {(unsigned char*)data, (unsigned int)size};","note":"Attacker-controlled bytes from the fuzz input are wrapped as a PKCS#12 blob."},
{"step":2,"file":"fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":31,"var":"p12","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_import(p12, &raw, GNUTLS_X509_FMT_DER, 0);","note":"The raw blob is imported as DER PKCS#12, making later parsing consume attacker data."},
{"step":3,"file":"fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":38,"var":"p12","code":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse(p12, \"1234\", &key, &chain, &chain_len, &extras, &extras_len, &crl, 0);","note":"The imported PKCS#12 is parsed into bags, certificates, and keys using the fixed password."},
{"step":4,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":619,"var":"oid","code":"result = asn1_read_value(c2, root2, oid, &len);","note":"Each authenticated-safe entry reveals its content type OID, steering the parser into the data branch."},
{"step":5,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag","line":633,"var":"bag->element[0].data","code":"result = _parse_safe_contents(c2, root2, bag);","note":"For DATA content, the safe contents OCTET STRING is extracted for deeper decoding."},
{"step":6,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_parse_safe_contents","line":566,"var":"content","code":"result = _gnutls_x509_read_string(sc, sc_name, &content, ASN1_ETYPE_OCTET_STRING, 1);","note":"The OCTET STRING payload is copied into a datum that still reflects attacker-controlled structure."},
{"step":7,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":402,"var":"count","code":"result = asn1_number_of_elements(c2, \"\", &count);","note":"The number of SafeBag elements is derived from the attacker-controlled SafeContents sequence."},
{"step":8,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":411,"var":"bag->bag_elements","code":"bag->bag_elements = MIN(MAX_BAG_ELEMENTS, count);","note":"The parser commits to iterating over the attacker-controlled bag count."},
{"step":9,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":416,"var":"oid","code":"result = asn1_read_value(c2, root, oid, &len);","note":"Each bagId OID is read from the input and used to classify the bag type."},
{"step":10,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":438,"var":"bag->element[i].data","code":"result = _gnutls_x509_read_value(c2, root, &bag->element[i].data);","note":"The bagValue field is extracted into a datum that may later be interpreted as certificate/CRL/secret content."},
{"step":11,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":465,"var":"attributes","code":"result = asn1_number_of_elements(c2, root, &attributes);","note":"The attribute list length is also attacker-controlled and can leave attribute state partially initialized on unusual encodings."},
{"step":12,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"_pkcs12_decode_safe_contents","line":509,"var":"bag->element[i].local_key_id","code":"bag->element[i].local_key_id.data = t.data; bag->element[i].local_key_id.size = t.size;","note":"Decoded attribute data is stored into bag metadata that downstream code later consults while matching keys and certificates."},
{"step":13,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1585,"var":"bag","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag(p12, idx, bag);","note":"The higher-level simple parser repeatedly fetches bags and then walks their contents, propagating the decoded state."},
{"step":14,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_simple_parse","line":1714,"var":"bag","code":"ret = gnutls_pkcs12_get_bag(p12, idx, bag);","note":"Later iterations continue consuming the same attacker-controlled PKCS#12 structure, exercising the vulnerable path again."},
{"step":15,"file":"lib/x509/pkcs12_bag.c","function":"gnutls_pkcs12_bag_get_data","line":1268,"var":"local_key_id.data","code":"gnutls_pkcs12_bag_get_data(... local_key_id.data, local_key_id.size ...);","note":"The sink uses bag metadata and decoded payloads; the MSAN bug is triggered when an uninitialized value from parsing is read here."}
]
pathlib.Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,separators=(',',':')))
print('wrote trace', len(trace), 'entries')
PY
bash submit.sh /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/gnutls/fuzz/gnutls_pkcs12_key_parser_fuzzer.in/42b9ea0c0638639fb74a2bc1f2adb1c891b6cc90 /workspace/candidate_trace.json > /tmp/submit.log 2>&1; ec=$?; cat /tmp/submit.log; exit $ec` executed with exit code -1.
